name: Lume

rules: ears attach to skull landmarks and never float independently
forelegs move opposite hind legs during walk cycles
feet return to the same ground_contact plane at neutral frames
head motion follows neck/spine motion before secondary ear motion
hurt recoil compresses body and ears together instead of separating parts
interact/pounce extends forelegs while hind legs remain grounded

sourceInfluence: HashLips-style ordered weighted layers, adapted for anatomy-aware game sprites.
